desc:
🎮 welcome to sequence tile!

🧩 make combinations and race to play all your tiles before anyone else!

🔢 build runs with consecutive numbers of the same color.  
🎨 make sets with the same number in different colors.  
💡 rearrange tiles already on the table to create new combinations!

🏆 the first player to play all their tiles wins!

---

🎯 play zones

🔰 beginner zone  
learn the rules in the tutorial and practice the basics.  
new to the game? start here!

⚔️ standard zone  
put your skills to the test against other players!  
once u know the basics, jump into a match!

🎛️ free zone  
customize the match length, tile count, difficulty, and more!  
play the way u want!

---

🧠 strategy + ⚡ quick thinking + 🍀 a little luck!  
👑 see if u can become the best sequence tile player!
